parameters.name: Cc
parameters.description: The country or region of the registrant. Specify a 2-character country or region code (refer to GB/T 2659.1-2022).

parameters.name: City
parameters.description: The city of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length. If the country is China, the value must comply with GB/T 2260-2007.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

parameters.name: DocumentCode
parameters.description: The document number of the registrant. The number cannot exceed 50 characters in length.

parameters.name: DocumentImage
parameters.description: The document image of the registrant (base64-encoded). The original file size must be between 50 KB and 3 MB.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address. The address cannot exceed 300 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the registrant. The name cannot exceed 255 characters in length.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The phone number of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 128 characters in length. If the country is China and the number is not a mobile phone number, the area code must match the city.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description: The province of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length. If the country is China, the value must comply with GB/T 2260-2007.

parameters.name: Street
parameters.description: The address of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length.
